capabilities: capture GPS coordinates into daily note properties
look up a formatted address from coordinates via AMap
fetch the day's weather forecast with temperatures
run capture automatically when opening today's note
reuse existing coordinates and skip capture when weather is already set
extras: Mobile-only (requires Obsidian Mobile 1.11.0+); AMap coverage is China-focused and the README includes full Chinese documentation. The API key is stored in plain text in plugin data and coordinates are sent to AMap over HTTPS.
problem: Daily notes contain no automatic real-world context; users must manually add where they were and what the weather was.

relations.evidence: with address lookup and weather data from AMap

summary: Mobile plugin that writes GPS coordinates, address, and daily weather into daily note properties using AMap lookups.
